project_name: Southgate Smoke Shop - Employee Attendance & Time Clock System
design_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL DARK KIOSK

typography.kiosk_clock_digits: text-5xl sm:text-7xl font-mono font-black tracking-widest text-amber-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.3)]

status_clock_in.button_gradient: bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-500 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-400 text-white font-bold

status_clock_out.button_gradient: bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-red-500 hover:from-rose-500 hover:to-red-400 text-white font-bold

status_break.button_gradient: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-yellow-500 hover:from-amber-500 hover:to-yellow-400 text-slate-950 font-bold

status_end_break.button_gradient: bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-600 to-blue-500 hover:from-sky-500 hover:to-blue-400 text-white font-bold

layout_and_spacing.kiosk_mode: Full viewport experience with zero scroll clutter. Top banner showing live store status, digital clock & ambient smoke shop branding. Center stage with twin view (PIN Keypad / Active Staff Quick Select + Huge tactile action cards).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_mode: Sidebar or top nav with quick view switcher (Live Dashboard, Employee Roster, Weekly Schedules, Timesheets & Approvals, Payroll Estimate, Attendance Reports, Store Settings). Dense, data-rich bento grid for metric cards with live pulses.

visual_enhancers.kiosk_pin_button: h-16 w-16 text-2xl font-mono font-bold rounded-2xl bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-700/80 text-white hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-slate-950 hover:border-amber-400 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-md flex items-center justify-center
visual_enhancers.kiosk_giant_action_button: h-28 sm:h-36 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all transform active:scale-95 shadow-xl border cursor-pointer
visual_enhancers.live_pulse_badge: relative flex h-3 w-3 inline-block mr-2
visual_enhancers.live_pulse_dot: animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75

features: Live digital clock with seconds & date banner
Employee list fast-picker OR PIN Keypad entry
Visual PIN dots indicator with clear & backspace buttons
Huge CLOCK IN, CLOCK OUT, START BREAK, END BREAK touch controls
Instant confirmation toast modal with employee photo, timestamp, audio chime toggle & duration summary
Quick supervisor lock/override option
Realtime Stat Counters: Currently Working, On Break, Not Clocked In, Late Today, Today's Total Labor Hours
Employee Status Grid with live timer counters, shift start time, and quick manager action menu
Recent Timeclock Activity Stream with timestamps and action badges
Store Shift Coverage Bar & Overtime Warning Alerts
CRUD Employee list with search & filter by role (Owner, Supervisor, Employee)
Modal/Drawer form for adding & editing employee details (Name, Hourly Rate, PIN code, Phone, Email, Shift Preference)
PIN Reset action with quick copy / SMS simulation
Active / Inactive status toggle
7-day Weekly Grid view showing shift assignments per employee
Shift creation modal (Start time, End time, Role required, Notes)
Copy Previous Week schedule feature & Publish Schedule trigger
Total scheduled hours vs labor budget projection
Filterable view: Daily, Weekly, Biweekly, Monthly
Detailed timecard records (Clock In, Break Start, Break End, Clock Out, Total Hours, OT Hours)
Manual time adjustment modal with mandatory manager approval reason note and audit log
Single & Bulk Approval buttons
Payroll calculation table breakdown per employee
Automatic Overtime calculation (1.5x rate for hours > 40 in a week)
Break deduction rules & Net estimated pay output
Export payroll summary modal
Interactive Date Range Filter (Today, This Week, Last Week, Custom Range)
Recharts visualizations for Daily Hours Worked, Punctuality/Late Trends, Labor Cost by Day
One-click CSV & printable PDF report generator with preview modal
Comprehensive log of all clock events with filters for Employee, Date, Event Type, and Flagged Anomalies
Download audit log option
Store hours configuration & Grace period threshold (e.g. 5 mins for late flag)
Overtime rules (Weekly > 40h, Daily > 8h)
Kiosk PIN Enforcement & Lockout policies
IP / Terminal registration setup

testing_and_data_ids.rule: ALL interactive components MUST include semantic data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure the app opens directly with a clean role switcher header (Kiosk Mode / Owner Dashboard) and pre-seeded mock data for Southgate Smoke Shop.
2. Store state cleanly in React context or localStorage so employee clock-ins dynamically update the Live Owner Dashboard immediately.
3. Build giant, highly visible touch buttons for CLOCK IN, CLOCK OUT, START BREAK, END BREAK on the Kiosk screen.
4. Use sonner or custom modal toasts for immediate feedback when an employee clocks in/out with exact timestamp.
5. Use dark-mode themed Tailwind CSS throughout (#090A0F background, #181A24 card surfaces, slate borders, bright emerald/amber/rose accents).
6. Include all required functional screens: Kiosk, Owner Live Dashboard, Employee Management, Work Schedules, Timesheets, Payroll Estimate, Reports & Export, Attendance History, Store Settings.
7. Attach data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, tabs, and stat cards.
